definition: Independent recalculation from completed bench-* memory JSONL captures. Memory is LM Studio process-group RSS and physical footprint; no inference, model loading or source-result mutation. Missing physical-footprint samples remain null and are excluded from its median and sampled peak.
limitations: Samples start after model loading, cover the four E2E cases and exclude model-load peaks.
One-second samples do not establish a continuous peak.
RSS and physical footprint measure different accounting scopes; neither alone or their sum proves required RAM.
No inference about compression, swap or GPU allocation is made.
